question:
A paper is folded and cut as shown. How will it appear when unfolded?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ffeda4c5499ec22e1458651c466216b605694396369356e0e11d82d57127595.png]
solution:
We unfold the paper step by step:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ced0077f18de44b2087108c4c5e8500b329420abfd608b4ff59c45abe0e19b9.png] 

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c03fc1e7aa79f65dd3870cec31c848942e988c459d50351cdb16ee07bf250c67.png] Extra rings at the corner.

**Option 2)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2739017d619247012a230ee18ab796b342ff54179bf083afec9c5abae4b86837.png] ** The pattern is correct.**

 

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/120b95a45e71bdc678dd45455abf31c2a77b3496d3c9c5ff7de3359369588f77.png] Edges don't have the cut.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/717225838ebdc1e91fc5915a9d5c3a8d2b094291001feb528ea5c0a602c9676f.png] Extra rings at the sides.

Hence, the correct answer is "**option (2)".**
